name: InventoryItem

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the inventory item

fields.name: productId
fields.description: Reference to the product in the catalog

fields.name: quantityAvailable
fields.description: Current available stock quantity for sale

fields.name: quantityReserved
fields.description: Quantity reserved for pending orders awaiting fulfillment

fields.name: isAvailable
fields.description: Indicates if the product is currently available for ordering

fields.name: lastSyncedAt
fields.description: Timestamp of last synchronization with external inventory management system

fields.name: reorderThreshold
fields.description: Minimum quantity level that triggers reorder alerts

description: Manages product inventory with stock levels, reserved quantities, and availability status for order fulfillment

relationships.description: An inventory item can be referenced by multiple orders

name: Order

fields.name: customerId
fields.description: Reference to the customer who placed the order

fields.name: orderDate
fields.description: Timestamp when the order was submitted

fields.name: totalAmount
fields.description: Total order value including taxes and shipping

fields.name: paymentStatus
fields.description: Current payment status (pending, verified, failed, refunded)

fields.name: fulfillmentStatus
fields.description: Current fulfillment stage (submitted, approved, allocated, shipped, delivered, cancelled)

fields.name: trackingNumber
fields.description: Shipping carrier tracking number for delivery monitoring

description: Central data model capturing order lifecycle from submission through delivery, including customer details, payment status, and fulfillment tracking
